Location: Face
Quantity: 1
Method: Salicylic acid
Chemical: Skin Medica Illuminize Peel
Area treated: Face
Discussed diagnosis, alternative treatment, risks and benefits of each treatment. Side effects discussed included but is not limited to erythema, edema, infection, delayed healing, pain, burning sensation, pigment problems, blisters, scarring, keloids, allergic reactions, recurrence of problems and worsening and/or no treatment effects of current skin condition. RD Rapid Recovery Cream + RD Pro-Tect Hydrating SPF 40 was applied after procedure. The patient tolerated the procedure well
